                         runtime_version = ?, install_cmd = ?, build_cmd = ?, start_cmd = ?,
                         migrate_cmd = ?, output_dir = ?, health_path = ?, startup_budget_secs = ?,
                         memory_mb = ?, cpu_percent = ?, pause_for_migrations = ?,
                         updated_at = datetime('now')
         WHERE id = ?
